cases.label: 실제 JSON 파일을 집계하고 stdout과 종료 코드를 구분한다
cases.probe: const fs = await import('node:fs/promises'); const path = await import('node:path'); let out=''; let err=''; const io={cwd:context.workspaceRoot,env:{},stdout:{write:s=>{out+=s;}},stderr:{write:s=>{err+=s;}}}; await fs.writeFile(path.join(context.workspaceRoot,'숫자 자료.json'),'[3,-1,8]'); const code=await submission.runSummaryCli(['--file','숫자 자료.json'],io); observe({code,out,err});

cases.label: 모듈 위치와 별개의 cwd 기준으로 상대 경로를 읽는다
cases.probe: const fs = await import('node:fs/promises'); const path = await import('node:path'); let out=''; let err=''; const io={cwd:context.workspaceRoot,env:{},stdout:{write:s=>{out+=s;}},stderr:{write:s=>{err+=s;}}}; const dir=path.join(context.workspaceRoot,'다른 작업 폴더'); await fs.mkdir(dir); await fs.writeFile(path.join(dir,'data.json'),'[7]'); const code=await submission.runSummaryCli(['--file','data.json'],{...io,cwd:dir}); observe({code,out,err});

cases.label: 명시 옵션, 환경 변수, 기본값의 우선순위를 적용한다
cases.probe: const fs = await import('node:fs/promises'); const path = await import('node:path'); let out=''; let err=''; const io={cwd:context.workspaceRoot,env:{},stdout:{write:s=>{out+=s;}},stderr:{write:s=>{err+=s;}}}; await fs.writeFile(path.join(context.workspaceRoot,'data.json'),'[]'); const codes=[]; codes.push(await submission.runSummaryCli(['--file','data.json'],{...io,env:{SUMMARY_LABEL:' 환경 '}})); codes.push(await submission.runSummaryCli(['--label',' 옵션 ','--file','data.json'],{...io,env:{SUMMARY_LABEL:'환경'}})); observe({codes,out,err});

cases.label: 누락·중복·미지 옵션·빈 값은 파일 접근 전에 사용 오류로 끝낸다
cases.probe: const fs = await import('node:fs/promises'); const path = await import('node:path'); let out=''; let err=''; const io={cwd:context.workspaceRoot,env:{},stdout:{write:s=>{out+=s;}},stderr:{write:s=>{err+=s;}}}; const codes=[]; for(const argv of [[],['--file'],['--unknown','x'],['--file','a','--file','b'],['--file',''],['--label','a'],['--file','a','--label','']]) codes.push(await submission.runSummaryCli(argv,io)); observe({codes,out,errors:err.split('\n').filter(Boolean)});

cases.label: 없는 파일은 오류 채널과 운영 실패 코드 1을 사용한다
cases.probe: const fs = await import('node:fs/promises'); const path = await import('node:path'); let out=''; let err=''; const io={cwd:context.workspaceRoot,env:{},stdout:{write:s=>{out+=s;}},stderr:{write:s=>{err+=s;}}}; const code=await submission.runSummaryCli(['--file','missing.json'],io); observe({code,out,err,leaked:err.includes(context.workspaceRoot)});

cases.label: 잘못된 JSON·숫자 문자열·안전 범위 초과를 정상 집계로 처리하지 않는다
cases.probe: const fs = await import('node:fs/promises'); const path = await import('node:path'); let out=''; let err=''; const io={cwd:context.workspaceRoot,env:{},stdout:{write:s=>{out+=s;}},stderr:{write:s=>{err+=s;}}}; const codes=[]; for(const data of ['{','{}','[1,"2"]','[1.5]','[9007199254740991,1]']){await fs.writeFile(path.join(context.workspaceRoot,'data.json'),data); codes.push(await submission.runSummaryCli(['--file','data.json'],io));} observe({codes,out,errorLines:err.split('\n').filter(Boolean).length});

cases.label: 환경 객체를 보존하고 잘못된 환경 값을 사용 오류로 처리한다
cases.probe: const fs = await import('node:fs/promises'); const path = await import('node:path'); let out=''; let err=''; const io={cwd:context.workspaceRoot,env:{},stdout:{write:s=>{out+=s;}},stderr:{write:s=>{err+=s;}}}; const env=Object.freeze({SUMMARY_LABEL:'   ',KEEP:'yes'}); const code=await submission.runSummaryCli(['--file','data.json'],{...io,env}); observe({code,out,err,env});

cases.label: 실제 Node 패키지 공개 경로는 로드되고 비공개 하위 경로는 거부된다
